L131@P6: There shall be no such defects as rust, discoloration, leakage which may adversely affect commercial

L133@P6: 6. Standard Test Condition
L134@P6: 6.1. Environment Condition
L135@P6: Unless otherwise specified, all tests stated in this specification are conducted at temperature 25±2°C
L136@P6: and humidity under 65% RH.
L137@P6: 6.2. Measuring Equipment
L138@P6: (1) Amp-meter and volt-meter
L139@P6: The amp-meter and volt-meter should have an accuracy of the grade 0.5mA and 0.5mV or higher.
L140@P6: (2) Slide caliper
L141@P6: The slide caliper should have 0.01mm scale.
L142@P6: (3) Impedance meter
L143@P6: The impedance meter with AC 1 kHz should be used.
L144@P6: 7. Characteristics
L145@P6: 7.1. Standard Charge
L146@P6: Standard Charge means charging the cell CCCV with charge current 2.0A (0.5C), constant voltage
L147@P6: 4.20V and 0.1A cut-off in CV mode at 25°C for capacity.
L148@P6: 7.2. Maximum Charge
L149@P6: Maximum Charge means charging the cell CCCV with charge current 8.0A (2.0C), constant voltage
L150@P6: 4.20V and 0.1A cut-off in CV mode at 25°C.
L151@P6-7: 7.3. Standard Discharge Capacity-EVE Energy CO., LTD Confidential and ProprietaryModel INR21700/40PL Spec. No. PBRI-INR21700/40PL-D06-01 Version No. A

L190@P8: 7.9. Status of the Cell as of Ex-factory
L191@P8: The cell should be shipped in 3.450V to 3.600V charging voltage range.
L192@P8: 8. Mechanical Characteristics
L193@P8: 8.1. Free Fall Test
L194@P8: Test method: Each fully charged cell is dropped three times from a height of 1.0m onto a concrete
L195@P8: floor. The cells are dropped so as to obtain impacts in random orientations. After the test, the cells shall be
L196@P8: put on rest for 1h and then a visual inspection shall be performed.
L197@P8: Criteria: No fire, no explosion.
L198@P8: Free fall test is according to the IEC62133 standard.
L199@P8: 8.2. Vibration Test
L200@P8: Test method: For X and Y axis with cylindrical cell 7Hz→200Hz→7Hz for 15min, repetition 12 times
L201@P8: totally 3 hours, the acceleration 1g during 7 to 18Hz, then amplitude 1.6mm and maximum 8g up to 200Hz.
L202@P8: Criteria: No fire, no explosion, no leakage, with less than 10% of OCV drop.
L203@P8: Vibration test is according to the UN38.3 standard.
L204@P8: 9. Safety
L205@P8: 9.1. Overcharge Test
L206@P8: Test method: Fully standard discharged cell is charged with 4.6V and 12.0A (3C) for 7h.
L207@P8: Criteria: No fire, no explosion.
L208@P8: Overcharge test is according to the UL1642 standard.
L209@P8: 9.2. External Short-circuit Test
L210@P8: Test method: Fully standard charged cell is to be short-circuited by connecting the positive and
L211@P8-9: negative terminals of the cell with a circuit load having are resistance load of 80±20mΩ at 55±5°C. The -EVE Energy CO., LTD Confidential and ProprietaryModel INR21700/40PL Spec. No. PBRI-INR21700/40PL-D06-01 Version No. A
L212@P9: EVE Confidential
L213@P9: 5 / 12
L214@P9: cell remains on test for 24h or until the surface temperature declines by 20% of the maximum temperature
L215@P9: rise, whichever is the sooner.
L216@P9: Criteria: No fire, no explosion.
L217@P9: External short-circuit test is according to the IEC62133 standard.
L218@P9: 9.3. Forced Discharge Test
L219@P9: Test method: A discharged cell is subjected to a reverse charge at 4.0A (1C) for 90 min.
L220@P9: Criteria: No fire, no explosion.
L221@P9: Forced discharge test is according to the IEC62133 standard.
L222@P9: 9.4. Heating Test
L223@P9: Test method: To heat up the standard charged cell at heating rate 5°C per minute up to 130°C and keep
L224@P9: the cell in oven for 10 minutes.
L225@P9: Criteria: No fire, no explosion.
L226@P9: Heating test is according to the UL1642 standard.
L227@P9: 9.5. Low Pressure Test
L228@P9: Test method: Fully standard charged cell is to be stored at a pressure of 11.6 kPa or less for at least six
L229@P9: hours at ambient temperature.
L230@P9: Criteria: No fire, no explosion and no leakage with less than 10% of OCV drop.
L231@P9: Low pressure test is according to the UN38.3 standards.
L232@P9: 10. Warranty
L233@P9: The warranty period of cells are made according to business contract. However, even though the
L234@P9: problem occurs within this period, EVE won’t replace a new cell for free as long as the problem is not due
L235@P9: to the failure of EVE manufacturing process or is due to customer’s abuse or misuse.
L236@P9: EVE will not be responsible for trouble occurred by handling outside of the precautions in instructions.
L237@P9: EVE will not be responsible for trouble occurred by matching electric circuit, cell pack and charger.
L238@P9: EVE will be exempt from warrantee any defect cells during assembling after acceptance.
L239@P9: 11. Precautions and Safety Instructions
L240@P9: Lithium-ion rechargeable cells subject to abusive conditions can cause damage to the cell and/or
L241@P9: personal injury. Please read and observe the standard cell precautions below before using utilization.
L242@P9: Note 1. Customer shall contact EVE in advance if it intends to use the cell in applications or operating
L243@P9-10: conditions other than those described in this document.-EVE Energy CO., LTD Confidential and ProprietaryModel INR21700/40PL Spec. No. PBRI-INR21700/40PL-D06-01 Version No. A
L244@P10: EVE Confidential
L245@P10: 6 / 12
L246@P10: Note 2. EVE will take no responsibility for any accident that occurs when the cell is used under
L247@P10: conditions other than those described in this document.
L248@P10: Note 3. For the sake of safety assurance, please discuss the equipment design, its system and protection
L249@P10: circuit of Lithium-ion cell with EVE in advance, and consult about the high rate current, maximum charge
L250@P10: and special application in the same way.
L251@P10: 12. Guide for the Use of Lithium-ion Cells
L252@P10: 12.1. General
L253@P10: This chapter has been prepared to describe the appropriate cautions and prohibitions, which the
L254@P10: customer should take or employ when the customer uses and handles the lithium ion cell to be manufactured
L255@P10: and supplied by EVE Energy CO., LTD., in order to obtain optimal performance and safety.
L256@P10: 12.2. Charging
L257@P10: 12.2.1. Charging current
L258@P10: Charging current shall be less than maximum charge current specified in the specification.
L259@P10: 12.2.2. Charging voltage
L260@P10: Charging shall be done by voltage less than that specified in the specification.
L261@P10: 12.2.3. Charging temperature
L262@P10: The cell shall be charged within a range of specified temperatures in the specification.
L263@P10: 12.2.4. Reverse charging
L264@P10: The cell shall be connected, confirming that its poles are correctly aligned. Inverse charging shall be
L265@P10: strictly prohibited. If the cell is connected improperly, it may be damaged.
L266@P10: 12.3. Discharging
L267@P10: 12.3.1. Discharging current
L268@P10: The cell shall be discharged continuously at less than maximum discharging current specified in the
L269@P10: specification. In case of the higher discharging current should be set, it shall be discussed with EVE.
L270@P10: 12.3.2. Discharging temperature
L271@P10: The cell shall be discharged within a range of temperatures specified in the specification. Otherwise,
L272@P10: it may cause loss of performance characteristics.
L273@P10: 12.3.3. Over-discharging
L274@P10: The system should equip with a device to prevent further discharging exceeding discharging cut-off
L275@P10: voltage specified in the specification.
L276@P10-11: Over-discharging may cause loss of performance characteristics of cell.-EVE Energy CO., LTD Confidential and ProprietaryModel INR21700/40PL Spec. No. PBRI-INR21700/40PL-D06-01 Version No. A
L277@P11: EVE Confidential
L278@P11: 7 / 12
L279@P11: Over-discharging may occur by self-discharging if the cell is left for a very long time without any use.
L280@P11: The charger should equip with a device to detect voltage of cell box and to determine recharging
L281@P11: procedures.
L282@P11: 12.4. Storage
L283@P11: 12.4.1. Storage conditions
L284@P11: The cell should be stored within a range of temperatures specified in the specification. Otherwise, it
L285@P11: may cause loss of performance characteristics, leakage and/or rust.
L286@P11: 12.4.2. Long term storage
L287@P11: The cell should be used within a short period after charging because long-term storage may cause loss
L288@P11: of capacity by self-discharging. If long-term storage is necessary, the cell should be stored at lower voltage
L289@P11: within a range specified in the specification, because storage with higher voltage may cause more loss of
L290@P11: performance characteristics.
L291@P11: 12.5. Cycle Life
L292@P11: 12.5.1. The cell can be charged & discharged repeatedly up to times with a certain level of capacity
L293@P11: specified in specification.
L294@P11: 12.5.2. Cycle life may be determined by conditions of charging, discharging, operating temperature and/or
L295@P11: storage.
L296@P11: 12.6. Design of System
L297@P11: 12.6.1. Connection between the cell and the battery
L298@P11: The cell should not be soldered directly with other cells. Namely, the cell should be welded with leads
L299@P11: on its terminal and then be soldered with wire or leads to solder. Otherwise, it may cause damage of
L300@P11: component, such as separator and insulator, by heat generation.
L301@P11: 12.6.2. Positioning the battery in the system
L302@P11: The battery should be positioned as possible as far from heat sources and high temperature components.
L303@P11: Otherwise, it may cause loss of characteristics. The recommended spacing between the cells is more than
L304@P11: 1mm.
L305@P11: 12.6.3. Mechanical shock protection of the battery
L306@P11: The battery should be equipped with appropriate shock absorbers in the pack in order to minimize
L307@P11: shock, which can damage the cells. Otherwise, it may cause shape distortion, leakage, heat generation
L308@P11: and/or rupture and/or open circuit.
L309@P11: 12.6.4. Short-circuit protection of the cell
L310@P11-12: The cell equips with an insulating sleeve to protect short-circuit which may occur during transportation, -EVE Energy CO., LTD Confidential and ProprietaryModel INR21700/40PL Spec. No. PBRI-INR21700/40PL-D06-01 Version No. A
L311@P12: EVE Confidential
L312@P12: 8 / 12
L313@P12: battery assembly and/or system operation. If the cell sleeve is damaged by some cause such as outside
L314@P12: impact, it may cause short-circuit with some wiring inside the battery.
L315@P12: 12.6.5. Connection between the battery and charger/system
L316@P12: The battery should be designed to be connected only to the specified charger and system. A reverse
L317@P12: connection of the battery, even in the specified system, should be avoided by employing special battery
L318@P12: design such as a special terminal.
L319@P12: 12.6.6. Pack design
L320@P12: The current consumption of the battery pack should be under 10uA at sleep mode. The system should
L321@P12: be equipped with a device to monitor each voltage of cell block to avoid cell imbalance which can cause
L322@P12: damage to the cells.
L323@P12: The battery pack or system should have warning system such as over temperature, over voltage, over
L324@P12: current, and so on.
L325@P12: 12.7. Battery Pack Assembly
L326@P12: 12.7.1. Prohibition of usage of damaged cell
L327@P12: The cell should be inspected visually before battery assembly.
L328@P12: The cell should not be used if sleeve-damage, can-distortion and/or electrolyte-smell is detected.
L329@P12: 12.7.2. Terminals handing
L330@P12: Excessive force on the negative terminal should be avoided when external strip terminal is welled.
L331@P12: 12.7.3. Transportation
L332@P12: If the cell is necessary to be transported to such as the battery manufacturer, careful precautions should
L333@P12: be taken to avoid damage of cell.
L334@P12: 12.8. Others
L335@P12: 12.8.1. Disassembly
L336@P12: The cell should not be dismantled from the battery pack.
L337@P12: Internal short-circuit caused by disassembly may lead to heat generation and/or venting.
L338@P12: When the electrolyte with fresh water and seek medical advice.
L339@P12: 12.8.2. Short-circuiting
L340@P12: Short-circuit results in very high current which leads to heat generation.
L341@P12: An appropriate circuitry should be employed to protect accidental short-circuiting.
L342@P12: 12.8.3. Incineration
L343@P12: Incinerating and disposing of the cell in fire are strictly prohibited, because it may cause rupture and
L344@P12-13: explosion.-EVE Energy CO., LTD Confidential and ProprietaryModel INR21700/40PL Spec. No. PBRI-INR21700/40PL-D06-01 Version No. A
L345@P13: EVE Confidential
L346@P13: 9 / 12
L347@P13: 12.8.4. Immersion
L348@P13: Soaking the cell in water is strictly prohibited, because it may cause corrosion and leakage of
L349@P13: components to be damaged to functions.
L350@P13: 12.8.5. Mixing use
L351@P13: Different types of cell, or same types but different cell manufacturer shall not be used, which may lead
L352@P13: to cell imbalance, cell rupture or damage to system due to the different characteristics of cell.
L353@P13: 12.8.6. Battery exchange
L354@P13: Although the cell contains no environmentally hazardous component, such as lead or cadmium, the
L355@P13: battery shall be disposed according to the local regulations when it is disposed.
L356@P13: The cell should be disposed with a discharged state to avoid heat generation by an inadvertent shortcircuit.
L357@P13: 12.8.7. Temperature measurement
L358@P13: The temperature monitoring system (K-type thermocouple) is recommended to be placed in the middle
L359@P13: of the cell (30mm up from the bottom of the cell), and the accuracy of the temperature monitoring system
L360@P13: should be within ±2℃.
L361@P13: 12.8.8. Caution
L362@P13: The battery used in this device may present a risk of fire or chemical burn if mistreated.
L363@P13: Do not disassemble, expose to heat above 100°C or incinerate it.
L364@P13: Do not expose the cell to extreme heat or flame.
L365@P13: Do not short circuit, over-charge or over-discharge the cell.
L366@P13: Do not subject the cell to strong mechanical shocks.
L367@P13: Do not immerse the cell in water or sea water, or get it wet.
L368@P13: Do not reverse the polarity of the cell for any reason.
L369@P13: Do not disassemble or modify the cell.
L370@P13: Do not handle or store with metallic like necklaces, coins or hairpins, etc.
L371@P13: Do not use the cell with conspicuous damage or deformation.
